🕴️ Pose: Arms Behind Back
Standing with both arms clasped or held behind the back — formal, patient, or disciplined.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Arms Behind Back.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, draw both frame-visible arms behind the torso with shoulders gently pulled back and the spine upright. Do not force hidden hands or lower-body details into view. Female: drawing the arms back opens the chest, elbows close together. Male: drawing the arms back sets the chest open, elbows apart. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own back-held posture.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
